lessons.title: Advanced number theory foundations
lessons.objective: Build championship-level understanding of advanced number theory foundations and apply it accurately to unfamiliar problems.
lessons.core_teaching_content: Championship mathematics emphasises structure, proof intuition and non-routine reasoning. Look for invariants, parity, symmetry, factorisation, counting structure and useful bounds before long calculations. Check edge cases and hidden assumptions. Focus specifically on advanced number theory foundations. Identify the core ideas, common traps, evidence or procedure needed to justify an answer, and the verification step that protects against careless errors. Practise moving from recognition to application: identify the task, select a method, execute it carefully, and check the result against all constraints. Record errors by cause so revision targets the underlying weakness.
examples: A National Mathematics Championship problem on advanced number theory foundations should begin by identifying the exact clue or condition that determines the method.
Create a new advanced number theory foundations problem with a plausible distractor and explain why the correct solution satisfies every condition.
lessons.practical_activity: Complete a focused National Mathematics Championship activity on advanced number theory foundations using a worked problem, comparison table, diagram, passage or data set as appropriate.
lessons.guided_practice: Work through three scaffolded tasks on advanced number theory foundations: model the first, prompt the second, and require an independent solution to the third with explicit justification.
independent_practice: Solve three unfamiliar advanced number theory foundations questions without viewing solutions.
Create and solve one new challenge using the lesson principle.
Analyse one error and state the rule that would prevent it next time.
lessons.assessment_checkpoint: Complete an eight-item National Mathematics Championship checkpoint on advanced number theory foundations; target at least six correct and justify every uncertain answer.
lessons.student_task: Produce one finished championship task demonstrating advanced number theory foundations and show the reasoning or evidence used.
lessons.tutor_guidance: Coach for precise definitions, explicit reasoning and independent verification. Do not replace productive struggle with immediate answers. Suitable for self-learning.
lessons.reflection_completion: Record one strength, one recurring error and one measurable action for improving advanced number theory foundations.
lessons.daily_flow: Learn → Worked Example → Guided Challenge → Independent Practice → Check → Reflect
